# BAD-049 — Split scripts/web-api.js (1005 lines) into a router plus scripts/web-api/ modules

## Brief
Plan: [[docs/spikes/bad-036/scripts-web-api|scripts-web-api spike]] (Goldrush, BADS-036).

Proposed: a 125-line router plus 12 modules under scripts/web-api/, the largest about 180; nothing over 250. The render container needs .dockerignore, scripts/check-image.js and the deploy-render.yml path filter updated in the same PR; without the path filter a change inside scripts/web-api/ merges and never deploys.

Open question for Eric: 12 modules, or one of the three merges the spike lists.

Cross-ticket: [[BAD-039]] (one BT_CORS_ORIGINS parser shared with render-server.js) lands after this split and must not add a third copy.

Verification: the tests that cover web-api.js, npm run web and npm run web:local, a check-image run on the render container build, and the function-body move check.

**Gate.** Queued until Eric approves the proposed file layout in the spike. Phase 2 does not start before that approval, and an approval that changes the layout is written into the spike's section 4 first.

**Rules for Phase 2, from BAD-036.** Split by responsibility; 250 lines is where a file gets a second look, not a cap, and every file left over 250 is argued in the spike's section 6. Every PR is a pure move: no statement is edited, a bug found on the way is its own ticket, and the spike's behaviour-preservation check (section 8) runs on every PR. The public surface in section 2 is the compatibility contract and does not change. Extraction order follows section 9: shared constants, types and pure utilities first, then state and services, then sub-components or handlers, then the entry file reduced to an orchestrator. Verification is the implementing-changes skill's tier for the files touched, quoted in each PR.

## Size, persona and model decision
Approved by Eric 2026-09-15 in this session: section 4's 12 modules unchanged, section 9's four PRs, and the section 8 F move-check script kept out of the repo (scratchpad only, output quoted in each PR body). Phase 2 runs one PR at a time: one engineer on opus per PR in a worktree after bash scripts/worktree-init.sh, then a reviewer on opus (Fable's weekly limit is reached, as on BAD-044) rerunning the pure-move proof before Spud commits, opens and merges the PR. The next PR branches from origin/main after the previous one merges.

## Outcome
Landed in four PRs, each a pure move proven against the pre-split file and each merged on the first attempt: #362 config.js and http.js plus the container plumbing (.dockerignore, check-image MUST_EXIST, the deploy-render path filter) and two new tests; #363 seam.js (with inContainer()), gate.js, scene-inputs.js and the three job modules, proven by real browser exports; #364 the four route modules with the try boundary preserved and a test pinning the thrown 400; #365 the twelve-module header map, the re-pointed comments and a sentence in each web doc. scripts/web-api.js is now a 140-line router over twelve modules totalling 1043 lines, largest route-render.js at 185; nothing over 250. Eric decided two things on the way: the layout is the spike's twelve modules in four PRs with the move-check script kept out of the repo, and putBlob takes the regex match (putBlob(req, res, url, blob)) because the moved body declares its own const key. Follow-ups: BAD-059 (P3) pins the thrown 400 on DELETE /session/:id and the three render routes, BAD-060 (P3) re-points five comments outside PR 4's list, and BAD-039 (P3) shares one BT_CORS_ORIGINS parser with render-server.js and must not add a third copy. The spike at spud:docs/spikes/bad-036/scripts-web-api.md now carries the putBlob correction and the dev-account handle note.
